hero.label: Next-Gen Energy Ecosystem
hero.title: Redefining Energy Freedom, Untethered.
hero.subtitle: Koral delivers clean, solar-driven EV charging hardware and high-capacity battery storage built for uncompromised off-grid mobility, commercial fleets and remote operations.

decentralized.title: Powering a Decentralized Future.
decentralized.text: As global energy demands rise and traditional utility grids face growing vulnerabilities, Koral provides autonomous, clean energy infrastructure. We combine high-efficiency solar harvesting, scalable storage and smart software to deliver dependable power anywhere on Earth.

deepDive.title: Every Component Is Ours.
deepDive.text: The BMS, the MPPT controller, and the firmware are all designed and validated in-house.

items.q: Do Koral units need any grid connection?
items.a: No. Every platform generates and stores its own power from solar input.
Nomad and Responder units deploy in under ten minutes with one person.
Every system is sized with a reserve margin based on your regional irradiance.
Yes. Trevoli aggregates telemetry across your entire fleet.
